set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/fit. Acceptance: split fit execution/result shape so dense/runwise/LSS do not downcast from a broad FitBlockResult; add selected-row/timepoint/voxel/run index types at fit boundaries; separate CoefficientFit from InferenceReadyFit or add positive ResidualDegreesOfFreedom so t/F inference cannot run on saturated fits; type T/F contrasts, statistic vectors, image-map kinds, GLS diagnostics, and LSS trial workspace variants; structure FitError reasons. Verification: fitJVM/test and fitJS/test, including saturated-fit regression and existing semantic contrast reordered-column scenario if present.
set.title: Type fit execution, inference readiness, contrasts, and image maps
